title: Baseball
paras: Baseball began in the United States.
The rules were written in 1845.
Most of the rules are the same today.
Fenway Park is in Boston.
It is the oldest baseball stadium in the United States.
It opened in 1912.
Nolan Ryan had a 100-mile-per-hour (161 km/h) fastball.
He has the record for most strikeouts.
He has seven games where no one got a hit.
Joe DiMaggio got a hit in 56 games in a row.
He got a hit every game for two months.
Cal Ripken Jr. played in the most games without missing one.
He played in 2,632 games in a row.
He played every game for more than 16 years.
The New York Mets earned the name 'Miracle Mets' in 1969.
They had never had a winning season.
This season started the same.
The Mets had 18 wins after 41 games.
Then they surprised everybody.
They went on to win the World Series!
1990 was a bad year for Atlanta and Minnesota.
They ended their seasons in last place.
Things changed the next year.
Both teams played in the 1991 World Series.
They went from bad to best in one year.
Minnesota won.
It took 7 games.

notes.phonics: 이 지문에는 짧은 u 소리 단어가 없어서 a와 i를 두 번씩 냈습니다. h_d·h_t·g_t·b_d가 모양이 비슷하니 뜻을 먼저 읽고 모음을 고르게 해 주세요.
notes.scan: 네 문항 모두 답이 숫자나 도시 이름입니다. 이 지문은 숫자가 아주 많으니(1845·1912·56·2,632·1969·7) 어느 숫자를 묻는지 손가락으로 짚어 주세요.
notes.tf: 4번은 never(한 번도 없다)를 every year(매년)로 뒤집었습니다. '기적의 메츠'라는 이름이 왜 붙었는지가 여기에 있어요 — 한 번도 못 이기던 팀이 갑자기 우승했으니까요. 맞히면 그 얘기를 해 주세요.
notes.trace: 두 번째는 두 낱말뿐입니다. 대문자와 마침표만 봐 주세요.
